About Zunaira

Celebrity Artistry.
Now Serving the UK.

10 Years. 3,000+ Clients.
One Standard — Perfection.

Zunaira is Pakistan's most trusted celebrity SPMU artist, having worked with A-list clients, media personalities, and thousands of women who wanted to wake up beautiful — every single day.

Trained in Dubai with PhiBrows and BioTouch — two of the most prestigious SPMU certification programmes in the world — she brings unmatched precision and artistry to every procedure.

Now based in West Midlands, Zunaira is taking a limited number of appointments for brows, lips, liner, and scalp micropigmentation — bringing the same celebrity-standard results to Birmingham.

PhiBrows Certified BioTouch Certified Dubai Trained 10+ Years 3,000+ Procedures
